name: agentic-sdlc-kit
description: Runtime guard Mods for the Agentic SDLC Kit (user-scope install, no per-project files)

plugins.name: sdlc-controller
plugins.description: Entry point for SDLC workflows in Claude Code. Maps /agentic feature|fix|app intents to agentic-sdlc-kit workflow starts via sdlc-bridge.

plugins.name: evidence-gate
plugins.description: Observes build/test/lint/typecheck commands, records exit codes with git fingerprints, invalidates evidence on relevant file changes, and blocks completion claims while required checks are MISSING or STALE.

plugins.name: change-contract
plugins.description: Boundaries implementation to an approved contract (objective / allowed / forbidden / required evidence). Warns or blocks Edit/Write outside allowed scopes; requires explicit user action to amend.

plugins.name: tdd-conductor
plugins.description: Enforces RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR. Validates that RED failures are behavioral (not compilation), keeps cycle evidence, and prevents skipping RED without an approved exception.

plugins.name: regression-orchestrator
plugins.description: Risk-based regression scope selection (targeted / component / cross-component / full) with a configurable, explainable risk score.

plugins.name: pr-readiness
plugins.description: Aggregates scope compliance, evidence freshness, review findings and unexplained files into a merge decision; generates PR descriptions that never claim unverified checks.

plugins.name: architecture-guard
plugins.description: Layer and dependency boundary enforcement from declarative rules; baselines existing violations and blocks only newly introduced ones.

plugins.name: release-conductor
plugins.description: Release gate: aggregates PR readiness, changelog/version checks, migration detection, deployment and rollback checklists. Never deploys autonomously in v1.
